mentions.name: Mosaichord
mentions.description: MPE MIDI controller with pressure-sensitive keys that uses just intonation tuning, with 28 notes per octave where all note frequencies are related by whole number ratios. The firmware is open source and ships with a detailed user manual; an on-board synthesizer (enabled by a previously added DAC) is being developed so the controller can be used without a laptop or external hardware synth.
mentions.source_excerpt: For awhile I've been working on an MPE MIDI controller called the Mosaichord.  It uses a tuning system called just intonation, where the frequencies of all the notes are related to each other by whole number ratios.  I'm using a scale that has 28 notes per octave.  Keys are pressure sensitive.
